questions.answer: Based on this site's article on the 40-word rule, Joe recommends starting each section with a heading phrased as a natural question users ask, then writing a direct answer block of 40 to 60 words right after it, with no preamble and starting with the subject and a verb [2]. Expand with supporting evidence, examples, or data afterward, since that part can be longer while the answer block cannot [2].
